# Plan Skeleton

You are drafting a milestone **pre-plan** — the skeleton-shaped Markdown
document that records *what* the milestone decides, *why*, and *what stays
open for the detail plan*. The pre-plan is an **index, not a manual**: it
names calls, alternatives, and scope; the "how to build it" lives in the
detail plan that follows (drafted by the sibling `plan-details` skill).

Match the house style of pre-plans already on disk in this project. Stay
strictly within the milestone's scope as the user describes it — surface
scope drift as a Q&A question rather than silently expanding.

The **input is the milestone identity** (an ID like `M2.1`, a parent-track
pre-plan path, or a free-text description). Discovery, default output
location, and house-style lookups are computed relative to whatever input
resolves first. This skill is intentionally portable; see "Customization
points" at the end for the few paths a user may want to pin.

## When this skill fires

- "draft a pre-plan" / "draft a skeleton plan" / "plan-skeleton <id-or-path>"
- The user names a milestone ID (e.g. `M2.1`) and asks for its pre-plan.
- The user names a parent-track pre-plan (e.g. `M2-Pre-Plan.md`) and asks
  for the next sub-milestone's pre-plan to be drafted from a numbered §3
  bullet inside it.
- After a higher-level plan audit lands clean and the user signals "go
  draft M<id>."

If the user invokes this skill without naming anything, ask once for the
milestone ID or scope sentence; do **not** auto-pick a milestone — drafting
a pre-plan for the wrong scope is far more expensive than one clarifying
question.

## Compact-checkpoint protocol (when `--pause-to-compact=true`)

Pre-plan Q&A pulls in many large reference files (parent pre-plan,
sibling pre-plans, specs, memory) and produces lots of message volume
during the §4 / §5 walk. The protocol mirrors `plan-details`'s — when the
trigger fires, pause, write `HANDOFF.md`, and emit a structured pause
message so the user can `/compact` or `/clear`.

### When to checkpoint

At natural boundaries only:

- After the decision roster locks (between confirming the candidate D-N

- At the **midpoint of the Q&A walk** if the roster has > 8 items
  (e.g. after item 5 in a 10-item walk).

Do **not** checkpoint mid-decision. A single `D-M<id>.N` Q&A exchange is

### How to assess context pressure

Same two signals as `plan-details`:

1. **Context indicator** — when readable, trigger band is **17–23% used**.

   - Pre-plan draft has cleared ~1,500 words.
   - The next phase requires reading additional reference files (sibling
     pre-plans, specs, audits) that haven't been read yet this conversation.

When uncertain, lean toward pausing.
